label: Outer Sunset storm-flood exercise
about: Synthetic Outer Sunset storm-flood exercise. Fictional; every report is authored. Suggestions and proposals here are AUTHORED fixture outputs (provider fixture), not model results. Team tracks are simulated. Packet sizes are estimated: packet bytes = 8.4 + 0.161 x text bytes, fit on 400 measured LLM-codec packets (replay_400.jsonl).

S01.text: School gym evacuation complete. Everyone our team checked is outside.

S02.text: North shelter open at the church hall. 18 people here, blankets needed tonight.

S03.text: House on 47th near Judah: water rising downstairs, two people waiting upstairs.

S04.text: 44th and Judah: power line down on the sidewalk, sparking. Keeping people back.

S05.text: North shelter: 24 people now, two with small kids.

S06.text: Apartment block on Judah: power out, elevator stuck between floors, nobody inside it.

S07.text: House on 43rd near Lawton: elderly man alone, no heat, needs blankets.

S08.text: 44th and Judah: kids trying to get close to the wire. We are holding them back.

S09.text: School sports hall checked. Our search of that area is complete.

S10.text: 47th and Judah: water at the second step of the stairs now.

S11.text: Strong smell of gas at 41st and Moraga. We told neighbors to stay out.

S12.text: Corner store: front window smashed by the wind, glass all over the sidewalk.

S13.text: Repeating: north shelter still needs blankets tonight.

S14.text: Parents gathering at the school gate asking about their kids. About 20 adults here.

S15.text: Grocery store at 45th and Judah is open, giving out bottled water.

S16.text: 41st and Moraga: we can hear hissing by the meter. Smell is stronger.

S17.text: Apartment block: stairwell lights out, residents using phone lights.

S18.text: 46th and Lawton: basement flooding, family pumping water, they need sandbags.

S19.text: 46th and Lawton: their pump is too small, water still coming in.

S20.text: 47th and Judah: the people upstairs have asked for help, water still rising.

S21.text: 43rd and Lawton: the elderly man says he is out of his heart pills.

S22.text: 44th and Judah: taped off the corner around the wire.

S23.text: House on 48th near Kirkham: dog trapped in the flooded garage. Owner is safe.

S24.text: North shelter: a woman here needs her insulin, it is still at home on 45th.

S25.text: 41st and Moraga: gas meter is on the side of the yellow house.

S26.text: Hardware store at 43rd and Lawton has sandbags. We need a truck to move them.

S27.text: School office says 212 students were on site today. Teachers have the roster outside.

S28.text: 46th and Lawton: family asks if they should turn off the power, water near the outlets.

S29.text: Apartment block: two residents on the 4th floor use oxygen machines, batteries running low.

S30.text: 47th and Judah: we need a boat or high truck, street water too deep to walk.

S31.text: Beach cafe staff are staying. We can serve hot food to about 30 people.

S32.text: 41st and Moraga: moved 8 neighbors to the end of the block.

S33.text: Grocery store at 45th and Judah: long line for water, about 60 people.

S34.text: Correction: the school gym is clear, but someone may still be upstairs in the main building.

S35.text: Repeating corner store: broken glass on the sidewalk.

S36.text: Repeating 44th and Judah: live wire on the sidewalk, still sparking.

S37.text: 48th and Kirkham: garage water about waist deep, we can hear the dog barking.

S38.text: School main building: stairwell door jammed, we cannot get to the second floor yet.

S39.text: Someone is shouting for help near the dunes. We cannot see where.

S40.text: 46th and Lawton: we helped them turn off the main breaker.

S41.text: Apartment block 6th floor: elderly woman cannot walk down the stairs, wants to stay.

S42.text: 44th and Judah: sparks getting bigger, small fire in the hedge.

S43.text: South shelter open at the church hall on Moraga. 25 people, we need cots.

S45.text: Repeating the school report: possible person upstairs in the main building.

S46.text: Repeating: insulin needed at the north shelter.

S47.text: Repeating: 47th and Judah, two people upstairs, need a high truck.

S48.text: 42nd and Judah: neighbor not answering her door, lights off since this morning.

S49.text: 44th and Judah: hedge fire went out in the rain. Wire still live.

S50.text: Repeating: gas smell at 41st and Moraga.

S51.text: 45th and Kirkham: tree fell on the roof. Family is safe, roof leaking.

S52.text: Beach patrol walking the dunes south of the parking lot, still hearing shouts.

S53.text: South shelter: a child here has a high fever. Parents want a medic.

S54.text: Truck delivered 40 bottles of water to the north shelter.

S55.text: Medic team brought heart pills to 43rd and Lawton. He has taken them.

S56.text: 40th and Moraga: car stuck in the flooded intersection, water at the doors, driver still inside.

S57.text: Repeating: dog trapped in garage at 48th and Kirkham.

S59.text: 40th and Moraga: intersection water about two feet deep, rising.

S60.text: Medic team at the apartment block. Oxygen users stable for now, need batteries within two hours.

S61.text: Grocery store: an older man slipped in the line and hit his head. He is awake.

S62.text: Beach cafe running on gas stove, no power. Still cooking.

S64.text: Truck dropped 30 blankets at the north shelter.

S65.text: Repeating: 42nd and Judah neighbor not answering her door.

S66.text: Sandbags delivered to 46th and Lawton. Basement water holding.

S68.text: Hardware store: 60 sandbags left, truck can take more.

S72.text: Repeating: 45th and Kirkham, tree on the roof, leaking.

S74.text: 40th and Moraga: threw a rope to the driver, he is holding on, trying to get out.

S75.text: Repeating: shouting for help near the dunes, south of the beach parking lot.

S76.text: Medic team at the grocery store, checked the man who fell. Small cut, no other injury.

S77.text: South shelter: 12 more people arrived, now 37. Still need cots and water.

S78.text: Apartment block: water coming into the parking garage, about knee deep.

S79.text: Has everyone at the school been rescued?

S80.text: 42nd and Judah: looked in the window, no one in the front room. Car is gone.

S81.text: Utility crew on the way to 44th and Judah, 10 minutes.

S82.text: 41st and Moraga: gas company crew is here, the gas is shut off. Neighbors can go back.

S83.text: Medic team brought insulin to the north shelter. She has taken it, doing fine.

S84.text: Earlier school gym report: all people our team checked were outside.

S86.text: Supply truck 1 loaded 80 sandbags at the hardware store.

S87.text: 46th and Moraga: checked the whole block, everyone is fine.

S88.text: Repeating: 43rd and Lawton, elderly man needs blankets and heat.

S89.text: School: one of the two missing students was picked up early by a parent. One still not found.

S90.text: 40th and Moraga: driver is out of the car and safe. Car still in the water.

S91.text: Dunes: shouting stopped. We keep searching.

S92.text: Correction for 42nd and Judah: the neighbor answered. She is fine, her phone was dead.

S94.text: Medic team at 47th and Judah. Both residents out, in our truck, mild cold.

S95.text: Truck brought 60 bottles of water to the south shelter.

S96.text: Beach cafe: hot soup ready, can send to the shelters.

S97.text: 45th and Kirkham: the tree also pulled the phone line down, it is lying in the yard.

S99.text: 48th and Kirkham: dog is out of the garage, owner has it.

S100.text: Apartment garage: someone may be sleeping in a car down there, residents saw him earlier.

S101.text: 47th and Judah house is empty now, door locked.

S102.text: Grocery store: water running low, about 50 bottles left.

S106.text: School main building search is not complete. We cannot give an all-clear.

S107.text: North shelter: 41 people, the hall is getting full. We can take about 10 more.

S109.text: 43rd and Lawton: elderly man moved to the south shelter with blankets.

S112.text: Corner store sidewalk swept, glass gone.

S113.text: Beach cafe: 5 volunteers here, can drive food to the shelters.

S114.text: South shelter received 20 cots. Still need water for 37 people.

S115.text: Beach motel: the car of the room 12 guest is still in the lot.

S116.text: Found the person near the dunes: a surfer with a hurt ankle, walking him to the parking lot.

S117.text: The neighbor from 42nd and Judah is at the south shelter, charging her phone.

S118.text: Apartment block: batteries arrived for the oxygen machines.

S119.text: 46th and Lawton: two neighbor basements on the block flooding too.

S120.text: 45th and Kirkham: tarp on the roof, leak stopped.

S121.text: 40th and Moraga driver checked by medic, cold but no injury.

S122.text: South shelter: the elderly man from 43rd and Lawton arrived, warm now.

S123.text: Repeating: motel guest from room 12 still missing.

S124.text: 46th and Moraga: water starting to come up the driveways now.

S125.text: Medic team met the beach patrol at the parking lot. Surfer ankle likely broken, taking him to the clinic.

S126.text: Repeating grocery store: about 50 bottles of water left.

S128.text: 41st and Moraga all clear, gas off, residents back home.

S129.text: Utility team set up a generator at the apartment block lobby for charging.

S130.text: Beach cafe sent soup to the south shelter with a volunteer driver.

S131.text: Hardware store: out of sandbags now.

S132.text: 44th and Judah: tape taken down, sidewalk open.

S133.text: 40th and Moraga: second car drove into the water and stalled. Two people inside, water at the windows.

S134.text: North shelter heater stopped working. It is cold in the hall.

S135.text: Man at the beach cafe says he is staying at the motel, room 12. He went out for food before the flood.

S136.text: School main building: fire crew opened the jammed stairwell door. Going upstairs now.

S137.text: 40th and Moraga: both people from the second car climbed out onto the roof. We are getting them a ladder.

S138.text: Supply truck 1 dropped 200 bottles of water at the grocery store.

S139.text: South shelter count: 52 people. Cots for 20, rest on mats.

S140.text: 48th and Kirkham: dog has a cut paw, owner wants a vet.

S141.text: Hardware store: 200 more sandbags coming from the city yard in 30 minutes.

S142.text: Beach motel manager confirmed: the man at the cafe is our room 12 guest. Everyone accounted for.

S143.text: School main building second floor: found one student hiding in a classroom, scared but not hurt.

S145.text: Apartment block 6th floor: checked the elderly woman, she has food and water, fine to stay.

S146.text: 41st and Moraga: gas crew checked all houses on the block, no leaks found.

S147.text: School roster: the student found upstairs is the one we were missing. All 212 now accounted for.

S148.text: Both residents from 47th and Judah dropped at the north shelter, warm.

S149.text: Utility team fixed the north shelter heater, hall warming up.

S150.text: 40th and Moraga: both people from the second car are on dry ground with the medic team. Cold but fine.

S151.text: Corner store: water coming in the back door now.

S152.text: Beach cafe: a volunteer burned her hand on the stove, needs first aid.

S153.text: South shelter: three families arrived with dogs, we need a spot for the animals.

S154.text: More sandbags dropped on 46th and Lawton for the neighbors.

S155.text: School main building fully searched, all floors. Nobody else inside.

S156.text: 42nd and Judah neighbor is back home, thanked the team.

S157.text: Grocery store closing at dark. Water handout moving to the north shelter.

S158.text: Medic treated the burn at the beach cafe. Minor, she is back to work.

S159.text: Apartment block: one oxygen machine stopped again, generator cable too short to reach the 4th floor.

S160.text: Beach patrol: tide coming up into the dunes, keeping people off the beach.

S161.text: Beach motel: ground floor water going down slowly.

S162.text: School: two students still missing from the roster, please send help.

S163.text: 46th and Moraga: one house has water inside, older couple on the ground floor wants to leave.

S164.text: North shelter: running out of food, 45 people for dinner.

S165.text: Apartment block: ran a longer cable to the 4th floor. Both oxygen machines running.

S166.text: South shelter: child fever is down, doing well.

S167.text: 44th and Judah: second pole leaning badly next to the first one. No wire down yet.

S168.text: Hardware store: city sandbags arrived, 200 ready.

S169.text: School gate: all parents have picked up their kids or are with the teachers.

S170.text: 43rd and Lawton: elderly man alone with no heat, please check on him.

S171.text: Supply truck brought a pump to the corner store. Water going down.

S172.text: Grocery store closed for the night.

S173.text: 45th and Kirkham: new crack in the ceiling under the tree. Family moved to the back room.

S174.text: Beach cafe: out of soup, will make more in an hour.

S175.text: 42nd and Judah: neighbor still not answering, we are worried.

S176.text: Supply truck 1 delivered 30 more cots to the south shelter.

S177.text: 46th and Moraga: helped the older couple out, they are going to the south shelter.

S178.text: Beach cafe soup delivered to the north shelter, enough for everyone tonight.

S179.text: 46th and Lawton: all three basements holding, pumps running.

S180.text: Motel guest from room 12 still missing, beach patrol searching the sand.

S181.text: Repeating: apartment oxygen machines running on generator.

S182.text: Medic team wrapped the dog paw at 48th and Kirkham, it is fine.

S183.text: Repeating: 200 sandbags at the hardware store.

S185.text: 45th and Kirkham: family left for the south shelter until an inspector comes.

S186.text: 47th and Judah: water still rising, people upstairs, hurry.

S187.text: Repeating: north shelter almost full, about 45 people.

S188.text: 40th and Moraga: tow truck asked for both cars, water going down.

S189.text: School: teachers and staff leaving, building locked.

S190.text: Apartment block: residents settling in for the night, generator on.
